Total inflow:
\[
8(420)+12(180)+6(240)=3360+2160+1440=6960
\]
liters.

Total outflow:
\[
20(420)+15(300)=8400+4500=12900
\]
liters.

Net volume:
\[
6960-12900=-5940
\]
liters.

Since outflow exceeds inflow, the tank loses water overall, so it cannot start empty and end full. Thus the conditions are inconsistent.

\[
\boxed{\text{No valid capacity; the conditions are inconsistent.}}
\]
